disclaimer: Platform policies change frequently and differ by region and account type. Nothing here is a substitute for reading the current terms of the specific product you intend to use. Every entry is flagged for re-verification.

activities.send_message: Send an individual message on the user's behalf
activities.bulk_messaging: Send messages to many recipients programmatically
activities.ui_automation: Drive the platform's own website or desktop app through its UI
activities.scrape_public: Collect publicly visible data from the platform
activities.api_automation: Automate using the platform's official, documented API
activities.post_content: Publish content to an account the user controls

platforms.name: WhatsApp / WhatsApp Business Platform
platforms.sanctioned_channel: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) with an approved business number and pre-approved message templates

send_message.reason: Permitted through the Business Platform for business-initiated conversations only with the approved template and messaging-tier system.

bulk_messaging.reason: Marketing messages require an opted-in audience, approved templates and are subject to per-user rate and marketing limits. Unofficial bulk senders get numbers banned.

ui_automation.reason: Automating WhatsApp Web or the mobile app with unofficial libraries breaches the terms and reliably gets the number banned.

scrape_public.reason: Collecting user data (numbers, profiles, status) without permission breaches the terms and privacy law.

api_automation.reason: The official Business Platform API is the sanctioned route.

create_account.reason: Automated account creation is prohibited and triggers verification systems that must not be bypassed.

risk_notes: Unofficial automation is the single most common way people lose a phone number they need for daily life.
Marketing to people who did not opt in also raises anti-spam law exposure (CAN-SPAM, PECR, Spam Act 2003).

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.sanctioned_channel: YouTube Data API v3 within its quota and API Services Terms
platforms.source_title: YouTube Terms of Service / API Services Terms

post_content.reason: Uploads via the Data API are permitted; content must comply with Community Guidelines and copyright rules.

scrape_public.reason: Accessing content by automated means other than through public search engines or the official API is prohibited by the terms.

ui_automation.reason: Automating the site UI to inflate views, likes or subscribers is a terms breach and an integrity violation.

api_automation.reason: Allowed within quota, with audit and compliance obligations under the API Services Terms.

affiliate.reason: Affiliate links are allowed but must not be deceptive; undisclosed paid promotion is an FTC and platform issue.

risk_notes: Monetisation is contingent on the YouTube Partner Program and advertiser-friendly guidelines.
Automated engagement inflation is treated as invalid traffic and can terminate the channel.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.sanctioned_channel: Instagram Graph API / Basic Display through a Meta developer app

post_content.reason: Publishing through the Graph API for business/creator accounts is supported.

ui_automation.reason: Automated following, liking, commenting or DMs are explicitly prohibited and lead to account restriction.

scrape_public.reason: Collecting data without permission breaches the terms; automated access to private data is prohibited outright.

api_automation.reason: Permitted only for approved use cases within the developer platform review process.

risk_notes: Third-party 'growth' tools that automate engagement are the fastest route to a permanently disabled account.
Influencer-style posts require clear paid-partnership disclosure.

platforms.name: Telegram

send_message.reason: Bots may message users who have started them; this is the intended use.

api_automation.reason: The Bot API is the officially supported automation surface, with documented rate limits.

bulk_messaging.reason: Only to users who initiated contact with the bot, and within the documented rate limits. Unsolicited broadcast is spam.

scrape_public.reason: Reading public channels via the documented MTProto API is possible, but republishing content still raises copyright issues.

risk_notes: Rate limits are explicit and enforced; respect them rather than working around them.
A bot must be disclosed as a bot - it must not impersonate a person.

platforms.name: Google services (Search, Workspace, Cloud)
platforms.sanctioned_channel: Google Cloud APIs, Google Workspace APIs and the Custom Search JSON API

scrape_public.reason: The terms prohibit circumventing technical measures and accessing services by automated means outside the provided APIs.

api_automation.reason: Official APIs are the sanctioned route and carry their own quotas and acceptable-use terms.

ui_automation.reason: Automating signed-in Google product UIs risks account suspension.

risk_notes: Use the Custom Search JSON API or another provider for search instead of scraping the results page.
Workspace automation should go through the Admin SDK / Gmail API with proper OAuth scopes.

platforms.name: Microsoft services (M365, Edge, Azure)
platforms.sanctioned_channel: Microsoft Graph API and Azure SDKs with appropriate app permissions

api_automation.reason: Graph is the supported path for mail, calendar, files and Teams.

ui_automation.reason: Driving locally installed Office apps on the user's own machine for their own documents is ordinary use; automating a signed-in web service against its terms is not.

scrape_public.reason: Automated access outside provided interfaces is not permitted.

risk_notes: Prefer Graph with least-privilege delegated permissions over screen-scraping a web UI.
Excel/PPTX/Word files the user owns can be generated locally without touching any service.

platforms.name: Stripe
platforms.sanctioned_channel: Stripe API with the account holder's own keys, test mode first
platforms.source_title: Stripe Services Agreement and Restricted Businesses

payments.reason: Permitted for the account holder's own business. The restricted-businesses list must be checked before onboarding.

api_automation.reason: The API is the intended interface; use test keys during development.

risk_notes: Keys must live in a secret store, never in source control.
Chargebacks and prohibited-use findings can freeze funds; keep clear records of what was sold.

platforms.name: PayPal

payments.reason: Permitted within the Acceptable Use Policy; some product categories are prohibited outright.

api_automation.reason: REST APIs are the sanctioned interface.

risk_notes: Buyer-protection disputes are decided by PayPal; keep delivery evidence.
High-risk categories face account limitation without warning.

platforms.name: Upwork
platforms.sanctioned_channel: The platform UI, used by a human. A limited API exists for reporting.

ui_automation.reason: Automated bidding or messaging breaches the terms and gets accounts permanently suspended.

create_account.reason: Multiple or automated accounts are prohibited.

payments.reason: Payment must stay on-platform; taking a client off-platform to avoid fees is a terms breach.

risk_notes: Proposal quality, not volume, is what converts - automated spray-and-pray also violates the terms.
Off-platform payment circumvention is one of the fastest ways to lose an account with escrowed funds.

platforms.name: Fiverr
platforms.sanctioned_channel: The platform UI, used by a human

ui_automation.reason: Automated activity and fake reviews breach the terms.

risk_notes: Review manipulation is treated as fraud and can void escrowed earnings.

platforms.name: Amazon (Seller Central / Associates)
platforms.sanctioned_channel: Selling Partner API (SP-API) and the Associates programme tools

api_automation.reason: SP-API is the sanctioned route, with its own data-protection policy and rate limits.

scrape_public.reason: Scraping product pages breaches the conditions of use.

affiliate.reason: Associates links are allowed but the account is closed for incentivised clicks or self-referrals.

risk_notes: Review manipulation is aggressively policed and results in listing removal.
SP-API access requires an approved developer profile and PII handling commitments.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.sanctioned_channel: Official LinkedIn APIs (restricted partner programme) only

ui_automation.reason: The user agreement prohibits bots and other automated methods of accessing the service.

scrape_public.reason: Public-data scraping is both a terms breach and legally contested; courts have reached different conclusions in different cases.

risk_notes: Automation tools that use your own session are a well-known cause of permanent restriction.
Manual, personalised outreach is both compliant and more effective.

platforms.name: OpenAI platform (example model provider)
platforms.sanctioned_channel: The API, used within the usage policies and rate limits

api_automation.reason: Permitted within the usage policies: no illegal activity, no deception, no adult content without safeguards, no tailored legal/medical advice without human review.

bulk_messaging.reason: Generating bulk unsolicited content or deceptive personas is prohibited.

risk_notes: Disclose AI involvement where it is materially relevant.
Rate limits are contractual; working around them with rotating keys is a terms breach.
